'''Gade Yedan''' was [[Gyr Keela]]'s assistant at the [[Mrlsst Trade and Science Academy]]. He held Keela in great contempt, feeling that the [[Mrlssi]] was nothing more than bluster and had no ability.

==Biography==
Yedan, in secret the leader of [[Ante-Endor Association]], and while playing the paper of competent and loyal secretary of Gyr Keela, was involved in the plot to steal the plans for the [[Phantom Project]]'s cloaking device, and the discrediting of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. In this capacity, he reported directly to [[Loka Hask]]. However, when he followed Hask into [[Rorax Falken]]'s lab, he attempted to capture at gunpoint some members of Rogue Squadron along with the musics of the [[Ghost Jedi]] group, but, using a trick, they disarmed and beat him, escaping. A beaten Yedan joined Loka Hask into Rorax' lab, uncovering his real work. He warned Loka about the imminent threat they were, but Hask "thanked" himn for his service shoting him. However, Hask was unable to escape, and shortly after, Yedan's body, Loka and the entire asteroid was consumed by a wormhole created by the gravitic polarization beam.
